description: Put the project on the map: an address (looked up; the first match is used, and the matches are returned) or latitude/longitude, and north: degrees true north is turned clockwise from the plan's north (up). The map, terrain and neighbouring buildings load around it, and set_sun can then light it. Changes the project's saved site (not an undo step).

address.description: Street address or place, e.g. "322 King William St, Adelaide"

north.description: Degrees clockwise from plan north (default: unchanged, 0 for a new site)

name: set_site
title: Set the site location
